subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Mr. Brown teaches English in a small mountain school.”?
options: It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.
But after a week, many students found that starting was the hardest part.
Every Monday morning, he asks his students one question: "What made you smile last week"
Every Wednesday morning, two students read school news on the radio.

本文可直接核對「Every Monday morning, he asks his students one question: 'What made you smile last week'」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Every Wednesday morning, two students read school news on the radio.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
